$comment: Hand-maintained facts the HTML parser cannot derive from table structure. Every entry cites the docs page it comes from and is listed in unresolved.md under 'Overrides applied'. No descriptions, only signatures.

classParents.reason: The vector page documents shared methods under 'Common Methods and Properties' and states they apply to every vector type.

eventCallbackReturnsBoolean.reason: The event page states the callback must return a boolean deciding whether the entity keeps drawing.

extraFields.name: urls
extraFields.reason: Documented as a heading without a signature table; the manifest urls map becomes Plugin.urls.<name>.

extraFields.name: resources
extraFields.reason: Documented as a heading without a signature table; nested folders become nested tables.

fieldTypes.name: isPaused
fieldTypes.reason: The row has no type cell; it describes a paused state and sits beside isPlaying, which is Bool.

fieldTypes.name: id
fieldTypes.reason: The row has no type cell; it is described as a numeric ID and audio.Stop takes it as soundInstanceID : Int.

fieldTypes.name: transitionMaskSprite
fieldTypes.reason: The type cell reads (Read-only); it is described as a sprite ID and SwitchCamera takes the same value as transitionMaskSpriteID : Int.

classes.name: PluginAudioResource
classes.reason: Opaque handle for a plugin-provided audio resource; the audio page passes Plugin.resources.<name> to audio.Play and no page lists fields.

classes.name: RuntimeSprite
classes.reason: Documented under its own heading as an opaque runtime-generated sprite object with no properties or methods.

derivedClasses.name: ui.TextDataConfig
derivedClasses.reason: The common types page defines it as TextData without the content property and without methods; the example constructs one with ui.TextDataConfig.new().

derivedClasses.name: ui.SpriteDataConfig
derivedClasses.reason: The common types page defines it as SpriteData without the sprite, spriteID and runtimeSprite properties and without methods; constructed like ui.TextDataConfig.

ownerPlaceholders.reason: Every client option shares one method set; the docs write the owner as a placeholder. Option names come from the lists on the same page.

returnTypes.reason: Signature line says Boolean, the returns table says Vector3; the table matches the method name.
Signature line says Boolean, the returns table says Integer; a count is an integer.
Signature line says Boolean, the returns table says Integer; a count is an integer.
Signature line returns two integers (height and line count) as the method name says; the returns table lists one.
Signature line says Cursor, a name no page declares; the returns table says CursorType, the config class.
The returns table repeats the value union shared by every Get variant; the signature line's table? is the structured-data type.
The returns table repeats the value union shared by every Get variant; the signature line's boolean matches the other setters.
Signature line says ShapeInstance, the returns table says ShapeEntity; GetInstance is the separate accessor for instances.
The returns table says Vector; a Quaternion constructor returns a Quaternion as the signature line states.
The returns table says Vector; a dot product is a scalar as the signature line states.
The returns table lists every interpolable type; the signature line shows only the last overload.
The returns table lists both interpolable types; the signature line shows only the last overload.
Signature line and returns table say Combo, a name no page declares; the constructor on this page creates a ui.ComboField.
The signature line's integer or string union is kept; the returns table lists only the integer case.
A lookup by name can miss; the signature line's optional marker is kept over the returns table.

renames.name: SetOptions
renames.reason: The heading and both code samples on the page call it SetOptions; the signature line carries the ComboField name.

renames.name: HasOption
renames.reason: The heading says HasOption, matching SetOptions and the other Option-named methods on the page; the signature line carries the ComboField name.

memberAliases.reason: The heading and the overview example use AddPoint, the signature line and its own example use AddPosition; both are emitted until the docs settle on one.

globalFunctions.name: PluginDependencyUpdate
globalFunctions.reason: Optional hook a plugin may define in global scope; documented on the structure page, which is not an API module page.

globalFunctions.name: PluginShutdown
globalFunctions.reason: Optional hook a plugin may define in global scope; shown in the client options example and the database tutorial, never declared as a signature.

aliases.name: PluginURL
aliases.reason: Values of Plugin.urls are the manifest URL strings; HTTPRequest.new takes one as baseURL.

aliases.name: InvTypeProxy
aliases.reason: The payload cell calls the value the inventory config; InvType is the inventory config class and the var page uses Proxy for config usertypes.

aliases.name: VarPlayer
aliases.reason: VarPlayer is a VarType domain (var.VarPlayer.<name>); the quest page types the same kind of value as VarType.

aliases.name: ui.LabelData
aliases.reason: No page declares LabelData; the row holds the header text properties and every other text property on the ui pages is a ui.TextData. Inferred, not stated.
